tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities Moments covers, with the slug to use in search_events and the city page URL. Data is public Moments event listings for Norwegian and other cities. Event texts come from third-party organizers.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming public events, activities and meetups on Moments in one city. Filter by time window, category, free entry or a text query. Returns event titles, times, venues, prices and the event page URL. Event texts come from third-party organizers. Data is public Moments event listings for Norwe

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one public Moments event by its UUID from search_events: title, time, venue, price, event page URL and a short description excerpt. Data is public Moments event listings for Norwegian and other cities. Event texts come from third-party organizers.
